technique_name: Compare Human Learning and Machine Learning.
description: The main difference between human learning and machine learning is that human learning is driven by experience whereas machine learning is driven by algorithms. Human learning is based on experience and may be harder to teach and transfer; machine learning is purely data-driven and can be taught through algorithms.
